study: Isotope constrained timing of actinium 225 purification
reference_time: EOB-equivalent reference for reported actinium ratios; parent-free baseline, with parent retention tested separately

half_life_sources.Ac225: Tan et al. 2025, p.1; source-consistent baseline; 9.9172 d tested separately
half_life_sources.Ac227: Tan et al. 2025, p.7, 21.7 years; 365.25 days/year

isotope_cases.label: Proton case
isotope_cases.source: Tan et al. 2025, Table 4, target 1-1, PDF p.8; dimensionless activity ratios, NOT percentages

isotope_cases.label: Nitrogen case
isotope_cases.source: Tan et al. 2025, Table 4, target 2-2, PDF p.8; dimensionless activity ratios, NOT percentages

recovery_cases.role: excluded from common-recovery calibration; development run; reported yield averages 1-1b and 1-1c
external transfer check; earlier protocol-development run

recovery_source: Tan et al. 2025, Table 2, PDF p.7. Comparisons are on the paper's reported reference-activity basis; common assay timestamps not provided. Not an independent experimental validation.
nominal_recovery_basis: Arithmetic mean of reported yields for stabilized runs 2-1, 2-2, 2-3. Subsequent prospective scenarios interpret this as a decay-corrected chemical transfer factor; sensitivity to possible double decay correction included.
timing_source: Tan et al. 2025, PDF p.6. A separate 60 h EOB-to-product sentence conflicts with 14 d cooling for target 1-2; it is not used to reconstruct a complete timeline.
threshold_status: Illustrative engineering constraints, not regulatory or clinical release specifications
